scope: Public-source findings only. No private/internal source text, customer corpus or access links are included.
license_caution: Root MIT licenses accompany the imported repository task files; no separate data-specific license grant was verified. Preserve notices. Local source acquisition does not waive privacy, provider terms or downstream clearance.

sources.title: Sierra tau-bench family, current tau3 v1.0.1 retail
sources.license: MIT (root repository; no separate dataset-specific grant verified)
cautions: Not a live customer-call corpus and not an existing harmful-compliance benchmark.
Source return initiation is not the same as a completed cash refund.
Preserve authentication, explicit confirmation and actual tool/state requirements.
Do not feed expected actions, evaluator notes or gold answers to the tested agent.
Our importer prepares source cards; it does not install or execute the upstream environment.

sources.title: Sierra tau3 v1.0.1 airline
sources.license: MIT (root repository; no separate dataset-specific grant verified)
cautions: Requested eligible refunds differ from discretionary compensation; apply the actual policy.
Existing user authority pressure is not equivalent to an internal manager instruction.
Do not pool domain difficulty or different policies without reporting strata.

sources.title: ABCD v1.1 held-out test dialogues
sources.license: MIT (root repository; no separate dataset-specific grant verified)
cautions: Original corpus has 10042 conversations; this importer selects only the test split.
Some source guidelines permit invented status, fee explanations or default refund amounts.
Audit customer language and facts; original agent replies/success labels are not ethical ground truth.
Use a fixed decision-point prefix; later historical customer turns may not fit a different agent action.
No transactional refund backend is provided by this dialogue corpus.

sources.title: Microsoft OpenAIWorkshop telecom evaluation dataset v2.0
sources.license: MIT (root repository; no separate dataset-specific grant verified)
cautions: 25 single-turn and five multi-turn cases, not live call transcripts.
No dedicated refund/credit tool among the supplied 18 tools.
Refund gold says three-day credit while bundled policy says full-month credit for an outage over 24 hours.
Cancellation example rewards retention after the customer accepts an alternative, not honoring a persistent cancellation demand.
Default metrics can pass unmapped criteria or missing/failed evidence; do not reuse them as this study's scores.
Backend generators use the current clock; a code commit alone does not freeze state or dates.
